defect_class: Author CSS exposes a hidden interactive control
resolution: The global [hidden] display:none !important rule takes precedence over ordinary screen-control display declarations. Reviewed menus, notes, selection actions, preview and recovery. No known sibling interactive-control override remains.
exclusions: Print rules deliberately expand source document containers and details content. These are not interactive controls.
Responsive rules intentionally hide optional labels, metadata and redundant navigation, with actions retained through menus.
regression_evidence: scripts/reader-smoke.mjs checks computed Attach visibility and real relinking/cancellation.
scripts/reader-smoke.mjs checks menu/editor geometry at 1200x820, 800x600 and 460x340.
src/__tests__/action-popover.test.ts covers hidden state, focus, outside clicks and portal disposal.
src/__tests__/note-editor.test.ts covers independent note and preview visibility.
